import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,re,subprocess
p=Path.cwd();a=json.loads((p/'historical-results-allowlist.json').read_text());r=json.loads((p/'reservation.json').read_text());terms=[str(i) for i in r['ids']]+[x['source_url'].split('/')[-1] for x in r['rows']];hits=[];scanned=[]
protected=['cmdrr','shoe-pair','code-loop','polynexus','crown','tournament','transitive-bunkbed','bunkbed','hat-','r395']
for name,h in a.items():
 if any(t in name.lower() for t in protected):continue
 f=Path(name);data=f.read_bytes();actual=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest();assert actual==h,(name,actual,h)
 s=data.decode();found=[t for t in terms if re.search(r'(?<![0-9])'+re.escape(t)+r'(?![0-9])',s)]
 scanned.append(dict(path=name,sha256=h))
 if found:
  hits.append(dict(path=name,sha256=h,terms=found,text=s));print('MATCH',name,'TERMS',found)
def save(n,x):
 z=subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),n],input=json.dumps(x,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True);assert z.returncode==0
save('history-matches.json',hits);save('history-scanned.json',scanned)
print('SCANNED',len(scanned),'MATCHES',len(hits))
print('DENIALS FULL', (p/'inherited-denials.json').read_text())
